sources.title: Model Parameter Memory Calculator (fp16 / int8) | InfyCalculator
sources.snippet: Weight memory follows a clean rule: parameters in billions times bytes per parameter gives gigabytes, so a 7B model is 14 GB in fp16, 7 GB in int8 and 3.5 GB in int4.
